text: In the coma of Halley's Comet, the crew of the shuttle Churchill finds a ship full of desiccated bat-like creatures and three naked humanoids [sleeping in glass cases|trigger|bringing something home]. Brought to London, the woman wakes and [drains the life from a guard|wants|feeding on the living], who rises two hours later hungry for others. As [the drained multiply through the city|rules|it passes to others], the surviving astronaut Carlsen, bound to her by a psychic link, follows her to [the altar of St Paul's Cathedral|images|holy and occult objects].
